tools.name: get_sovereign_reserves

tools.name: get_etf_flows
tools.description: Spot Bitcoin ETF net flows (latest day + trailing 5/30-day, per fund where the source reports it) — institutional demand. Attributed and dated; returns an explicit absent/stale/unreadable status rather than a figure it cannot stand behind.

description.name: get_network_signal
description.description: Bitcoin network hashrate level and trend. Takes no arguments. Returns { as_of, hashrate_eh (exahashes per second), pct_30d, pct_90d, why, disclaimer }. Example: {}. Information, not financial advice.

description.name: get_daily_brew
description.description: The day's machine-readable digest of the whole signal set — the CoinBucha Daily Brew. Takes no arguments. Returns { date, btc_price_usd, headline, signals_summary[] }, one summary line per signal with its strength, direction and one-line why. Example: {}. Information, not financial advice.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "scan_signals" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
